title: A prospective multicenter validation study of a machine learning algorithm classifier on quantitative electroencephalogram for differentiating between dementia with Lewy bodies and Alzheimer's dementia.
summary: A previously developed EEG machine-learning classifier was prospectively evaluated across Japanese centers to distinguish dementia with Lewy bodies from Alzheimer’s disease, providing multicenter external diagnostic validation.
